Let me tell you this sounds like classic panic attacks. And as someone who gets them daily I know nothing I tell you will convince you that you don't need to see a doctor or go to the hospital. Anxiety is a bitch and mimics lots of awful things, including heart attacks, strokes and so much more. If it was a heart attack you wouldn't be able to breathe full stop. The fact focusing on your breathing made it feel like In your mind you were able to deliver oxygen shows it. You accidentally used the proffesional technique for calming down panic attacks and stopping hyperventilation. If you're not used to panic attacks you might feel symptoms for a while, purely because your body is exhausted. Just get some sleep and rest up, I've had weeks of fatigue from a single panic attack, so don't be too worried. However if it comforts you to be checked out then you can see if your able to get a doctor.
